comment: The nemar-cli commit the observation schema and the two observer fixtures are copied from. The schema is written in nemar-cli (shared/contract/compute-observation.schema.json) and copied here byte for byte; the fixtures are what this observer writes, and nemar-cli holds the same bytes. Bump it deliberately: see docs/contracts.md. CI checks out exactly this commit; tests/observer/test_observation_schema.py compares against it.
